checked_profile.summary: A lending marketplace with bank-specific offers and state-dependent terms.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Provider role
facts.text: Upstart Network is not a lender. Regulated financial institutions make loans on its marketplace.

facts.label: Amounts and terms
facts.text: The page advertises $1,000–$75,000 with 3- or 5-year terms. State minimums and maximums vary; not everyone qualifies for the full amount.

facts.label: APR and fees
facts.text: Advertised APRs are 6.30%–35.99%, based on five-year rates offered in June 2026. Origination, late-payment and returned-payment fees may apply. The product disclosure states no prepayment penalty.

facts.label: Credit inquiries and collateral
facts.text: Checking rates uses a soft inquiry; proceeding with the application triggers a hard inquiry. Although many loans are unsecured, certain offers can involve a vehicle lien or liens on accounts with the lender; read the promissory note.

questions: What APR, origination fee and net deposit are in my actual offer?
